title: Maximum EMF expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly stated as $B L_{1} L_{2} \omega$.

title: Instantaneous EMF expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly stated as $e = B L_{1} L_{2} \omega \sin(\omega t)$.

title: Effective current expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly stated as $\frac{B L_{1} L_{2} \omega}{\sqrt{2}(R+r)}$.

title: Resistor power expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (4) must be correctly stated as $\frac{R B^{2} L_{1}^{2} L_{2}^{2} \omega^{2}}{2(R+r)^{2}}$.

title: Application of Faraday's Law
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly apply Faraday's law to derive the maximum EMF from the geometry and motion.

title: Use of sinusoidal function
description: Important: The instantaneous EMF must be expressed as a sine function starting from the correct initial condition (coil plane parallel to field at t=0).

title: RMS value calculation
description: Important: The effective (RMS) value of the sinusoidal EMF must be correctly calculated as $E_m / \sqrt{2}$.

title: Circuit analysis with Ohm's Law
description: Important: The total circuit resistance (R + r) must be used correctly with the effective EMF to find the effective current.

title: Power derivation from Joule's Law
description: Optional: The power in resistor R is correctly derived using $P = I_{\text{effective}}^2 R$.

title: Sign or geometry error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for using cosine instead of sine for the instantaneous EMF, given the specified initial condition.

title: Resistance omission error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for omitting the coil's internal resistance 'r' in the current or power calculations.
